content.body:
The five-axle and 6WD drive Laffly proved very capable and uwas sed extensively by the motorized infantry Dragoons. It was a robust multipurpose vehicle that acted as heavy prime mover and infantry transport as needed. German and Vichy French forces continued to produce and use them, even in Russia and North Africa.
The Laffly is unique in that it has 8 forward gears: 1-4 are low range gears, and are use for towing heavy ordnance; 5-8 are high range gears for normal driving. When starting without towing, just shift quickly up to 5th gear for a quicker move from rest.
content.brief: TYPE: 6WD Truck/Prime Mover TOWING CAPACITY: Heavy LOAD: 800 kg WEIGHT: 3900 kg SPEED (road): 66 km/h
